keywords: The Petitioner sought to set aside an order of abatement of appeal preferred by the Petitioner’s mother and the 2nd Respondent against the District Court judgement given in favour of the 1st Respondent in a declaration of title and ejectment action. Held - Appeal dismissed without costs for 12 years delay on the part of the Petitioner to prosecute the appeal.
